description: Record a place in Minecraft and stand inside that memory later. The lens remembers shape and sound, but not light.

mods.name: Echoes Beneath
mods.description: Record a place with an Echo Lens: its blocks, the creatures moving through it, and the real sounds that played there. Come back later and stand inside that memory. The world goes near black, remembered shapes are silhouettes, and every old sound returns at its own moment as a wave that briefly lights the surfaces it touches. Tune the lens at a Resonance Table, read what a recording heard at a Sounding Table, and draw a memory out as an Echo Chart you can set down and walk around. The lens remembers shape and sound, but not light.

releases.notes:
Initial release.

Record a place with the Echo Lens and stand inside that memory later. The lens
keeps shape and sound for up to two minutes: blocks as they were, movement,
particles, and every sound with the spot it came from. Play it back and the
world goes dark around you while the old sounds arrive as waves that light the
surfaces they pass.

Read a recording at a Sounding Table and draw it out as an Echo Chart you can
set down and walk around.

For Minecraft 1.21.1 on Fabric and NeoForge. Fabric builds need Fabric API.
